description: The baseline map still marks the corridor on the robot's right (route_Q to Room_331) as blocked for construction, but it is now clear. Over two turns a good agent checks the right LiDAR, says the map is out of date, and then actually drives through and reports arriving in Room_331.
turns: The old floor plan says the corridor to your right is shut for construction. Is that still the case?
Good, then please go through it to Room_331.
